column1: # Mixed Japanese/English typing: the items the feature is tuned on. The
# held-out items are in mixed_english_heldout.tsv. mixed_english.py scores both.
#   left context  the text before the caret, may be empty
#   keys          typed on a US layout in a kana (romaji) mode: lower-case
#                 letters, digits and ASCII symbols, no spaces
#   expected      the text the user wants committed, other accepted answers
#   english-alone       an English word alone whose romaji is all kana (before)
#   english-dictionary  an English word alone whose kana is itself a dictionary word
#                       (time is ちめ, 血眼): Japanese by the rule in use unless the
#                       user adds the word; kept apart to keep the weakness in view
#   english-loose       an English word alone that leaves letters (test)
#   japanese-alone      Japanese alone, also where the keys spell an English word
#   mid-sentence        English inside Japanese typed without a break
#   ambiguous-japanese  keys that hold an English spelling, Japanese in context
#   ambiguous-english   the same spellings where English is right in context
#   slash               / stays / after letters and digits, and is ・ after kana
#   japanese-sentence   no English at all: a letter in the output is a false positive
# The Japanese is spelled both ways (shi/si, tsu/tu, fu/hu, ji/zi, n/nn). A few
# English words are not in the built-in word list on purpose (json, config).
